treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Norway and the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1983), continued with Bosnia and Herzegovina by exchange of letters of 20 August 2008
eif_quote: Lovdata 1983-09-01-21: Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 31-10-1985; Merknad: 'Avtalen er videreført med Serbia og Montenegro og anvendes midlertidig med Slovenia og Kroatia.' | Art. 28: This Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after the latter of the dates on which the Contracting States have notified each other ... and its provisions shall have effect in respect of taxes on income and on capital for any calendar year beginning on or after the first day of January in the calendar year following that in which the latter of the notifications has been received. | Lovdata 2008-08-20-20 (in force 20-08-2008), para. 3: 'Overenskomst til unngåelse av dobbeltbeskatning ... undertegnet i Oslo 1. september 1983, får anvendelse fra den dag denne avtale trer i kraft. Dens bestemmelser skal ha virkning med hensyn til skatter av inntekt og formue som vedkommer det kalenderår (herunder regnskapsperiode som begynner i dette år) som følger etter det år da denne avtale trer i kraft, og etterfølgende år.'
source_title: St.prp. nr. 23 (1983-84), Vedlegg: Convention Norway-Yugoslavia 1983 with Protocol (English text) in Stortingsforhandlinger 1983/84 vol. 2a (National Library of Norway scan) + Lovdata traktat 2008-08-20-20 (Norway-Bosnia and Herzegovina succession by exchange of letters)

rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may be also taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
1. Interest derived from sources within one of the Contracting States by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

2. The royalties referred to in paragraph 1 of this Aritcle may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT in treaty; MLI not applicable to this pair)

notes: Former-Yugoslavia succession: the 1983 Norway-Yugoslavia convention, with protocol, continues between Norway and Bosnia and Herzegovina under the exchange of letters of 2008-08-20 (Lovdata 2008-08-20-20, in force the same day), with effect from calendar year 2009; it does not apply to Norwegian residents receiving pay from the Norwegian government for services in BiH. Original convention: Art. 28 - enters into force on the 30th day after the later notification, effective for calendar years beginning on or after 1 January following the year of the later notification (original effect 1986-01-01). Protocol: Art. 10(2) rate agreed on the basis of Norway's split-rate company tax system and Art. 11 on the basis that neither State levied WHT on interest - each with a renegotiation undertaking, but no automatic change. Text obtained from the official parliamentary bill St.prp. nr. 23 (1983-84) (OCR of National Library scan; English is the sole authentic language); Lovdata (traktat 1983-09-01-21) carries metadata only. Not MLI-covered: Norway does not list it.
